Ho Ke Qaidna Sham Payi Jandiyaan Write Up
Ho Ke Qaidna Sham Payi Jandiyaan Dhiyaan Najaf De Shah Diyaan.
Kadi Sir Ghazi Da Wekh Ke Kadi Sang Hussain Di Wekh Ke Khutbay Sunandiyaan.
Naal Akbar Na Nahi Ghazi Utoon Khalqat Chokhi.
Rab Jane Kinj Bazar Wich Bajiyaan Banwaan De Nal Raiyaan Raste Banandiyaan.
Koi Salar Te Koi Veer Almaan Wala.
Aynj Sham De Lashkar Samne Raiyaan Hosle Naal Bhirawaan De Mansab Nibhandiyaa.
Chanwaan Ban Ke Naal Raiyaan Wasday Pathraan Andar.
Shabir De Putar Nu Aasray De Ke Bazaraan Moraan Te Raiyaan Turandiyaan.
Kaisi Manzal Ayi Okhi Kofay Di Si Paishi.
Akbar Darbar De Samne Ghar Apne Piyo Da Wekh Ke Athro Bahandiyaa.

content = path.read_text().replace('چوکھੀ', 'چوکھی')

_, header, body = content.split('---', 2)
roman = header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].strip().splitlines()

assert len(roman) == len(source) == 11
assert all(not any(c.isalpha() and not '\\u0600' <= c <= '\\u06ff' for c in line) for line in source)

item.text:
Reconstructed all 10 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The verse grammar supports Punjabi, so I updated the language metadata to `pa-Arab` and verified that both versions have the same verse count and stanza numbering.

I rendered the ambiguous `sang` as `سنگ` and removed the repeated “Write Up” heading from the verse block. Only the selected lyric was edited.
